inputs.description: File .hex (relative to the root of workspace)

tasks.label: Compile e Simulate
tasks.command: mkdir -p sim && iverilog -g2012 -o sim/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out tb/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}_tb.sv rtl/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.sv && vvp sim/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out

tasks.label: Compile & Simulate RISC-V
tasks.command: test -f "${input:programPath}" && mkdir -p sim && iverilog -g2012 -s riscv_tb -P riscv_tb.PROGRAM_FILE='"${input:programPath}"' -o sim/riscv.out tb/riscv_tb.sv rtl/riscv.sv rtl/modules/*.sv && vvp sim/riscv.out

tasks.label: Simulate all HEX programs in tb/hex
tasks.command: mkdir -p sim || exit $?; found=0; for program in tb/hex/*.hex; do [ -f "$program" ] || continue; found=1; name=$(basename "$program" .hex); echo "===== $program ====="; iverilog -g2012 -s riscv_tb -P "riscv_tb.PROGRAM_FILE=\"$program\"" -o "sim/$name.out" tb/riscv_tb.sv rtl/riscv.sv rtl/modules/*.sv || exit $?; vvp "sim/$name.out" || exit $?; done; [ "$found" -eq 1 ] || { echo "No .hex files found in tb/hex"; exit 1; }
